{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sanvia Vitajuice Bar''' was a [[vitajuice]] bar on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Its clientele consisted almost entire of [[Emente/Legends|Ementes]], who liked to watch their food being prepared for them.

[[Mara Jade Skywalker]] and [[Kyp Durron]] drank here.
